summary: First-run testing of CONGREGA/Igreja Jornada (Node + tRPC + MySQL + Vite React). Wrote a full pytest suite hitting the tRPC endpoints via the public ingress and executed a Playwright pass over the frontend (welcome + authenticated home + role-gated routes). Backend: 27/27 tests pass, covering /api/health, auth.me (positive/negative), tenancy (church.mine for all 3 seeded roles), member journey (member.home + bible.enroll + bible.complete), member content endpoints (member.dailyDevotional, community.calendar, community.events, community.announcements, connections.list, ebd.classes), RBAC on care.pastoralSignals & care.recalculatePastoralSignals (pastor OK / member FORBIDDEN), admin.dashboard (admin+pastor OK / member FORBIDDEN), reports.monthly with month=2026-01 (admin+pastor OK / member FORBIDDEN), management.createAnnouncement and management.createEvent (admin OK / member FORBIDDEN). Frontend: without cookie, Welcome screen with 'Entrar na Jornada' renders; with app_session_id cookie set to the admin JWT the Home shows 'Olá, Ana', bible plan card (Gênesis 1), daily devotional, streak, and weekly agenda. Routes /devocional, /agenda, /avisos, /palavra, /oracao, /igreja, /perfil each returned 200 and rendered content without crashes.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: /admin and /pastor routes could not be validated in the automated run because the frontend preview URL is behind Cloudflare which triggered 429 rate-limits and a bot-verification page after ~7 consecutive automated navigations. In manual browser testing the app is expected to render fine (backend admin.dashboard and care.* endpoints all return 200 for the admin/pastor tokens). If E1 wants full automated coverage for /admin and /pastor, add small delays (>=1s) between route navigations or hit them directly with the cookie in a fresh context.
critical_code_review_comments: bible.complete requires the member to already be enrolled (bible.enroll must be called first). This is correct business logic but the seed script does NOT auto-enroll the demo member in the official plan, so on a fresh DB the very first member.home progress values are 0 and 'Marcar como concluído' fails until enrollment. Consider having scripts/seed_demo.ts auto-enroll the demo member for a smoother demo experience.

trPC error responses come wrapped as error.json.data.code (superjson envelope). Any consumer that parses tRPC errors must read that path; documenting this in auth_testing.md would save time for future testers.

server/routers.ts is a very large single file (>320 lines with tightly packed one-liners). Splitting routers per feature (auth, church, member, community, care, management, reports, admin) would improve readability and code review quality. Not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: ~78% (7/9 protected routes verified; /admin and /pastor blocked by Cloudflare bot check during automated run — not an app bug)

test_credentials: Seeded Bearer JWTs from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (admin-demo, pastor-demo, member-demo). Cookie name: app_session_id.
seed_data_creation: Test created one enrollment for member-demo in the official bible plan (bible.enroll), one bible progress row (bible.complete), one TEST_Aviso announcement and one TEST_Evento event. These are harmless demo rows in the seeded church.
context_for_next_testing_agent: tRPC + superjson backend on Node/Express + MySQL (NOT FastAPI/Mongo). Base URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Query inputs go as ?input=<urlencoded {"json":{...}}>. Mutations POST body {"json":{...},"meta":{"values":{"someDate":["Date"]}}} for Date fields. Auth via header 'Authorization: Bearer <JWT>' (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md) or cookie 'app_session_id'. tRPC errors are at response.json().error.json.data.code. bible.complete needs prior bible.enroll. reports.monthly requires input.month in 'YYYY-MM'. management.createAnnouncement uses 'content' (not 'body'). management.createEvent needs startsAt as a superjson Date. See /app/tests/backend_test.py for a working end-to-end example.
